edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to owner() to bypass the minting pause in mint.
mint reads the mintingActive flag to decide whether minting is allowed.
mint increments totalSupply by one after minting.
mint increments artBalance for msg.sender.
mint calls _setOGs to persist the years value for the new token.
noYears parameter is written into the _ogs mapping via _setOGs.
mint calls _safeMint to create the token for msg.sender.
_safeMint delegates the actual minting to _mint.
_mint writes the new owner into the _owners mapping.
_mint increments the recipient balance in _balances.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after state changes.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient contract.
withdraw derives the transfer recipient from msg.sender.
withdraw executes an external value transfer before returning.
local someone derived from msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer.
amount parameter defines the value moved out by withdraw.
withdraw onlyOwner guard invokes owner() for authorization.
setRoyaltiesReceiver onlyOwner guard invokes owner() for authorization.
setMintingActive onlyOwner guard invokes owner() for authorization.
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() against _msgSender().
owner() returns the stored _owner state variable.
setRoyaltiesReceiver writes the _royaltiesReceiver state variable.
newRoyaltiesReceiver parameter becomes the new royalties receiver.
setMintingActive writes the mintingActive flag controlling mint access.
_salePrice is multiplied by royaltiesPercentage in royaltyInfo.
royaltyInfo applies the royaltiesPercentage constant to the sale price.
royaltyInfo computes the local _royalties amount.
royaltyInfo returns the stored _royaltiesReceiver.
_tokenId parameter identifies the asset queried for royalties.
block.timestamp is consumed by getCurrentYear to derive the year.
getCurrentYear converts block.timestamp through timestamp2year.
current year output feeds the makeArt artwork generation.
the _ogs years value drives the artwork produced by makeArt.
tokenURI calls makeArt to generate the SVG art.
tokenURI reads the _ogs mapping for the requested token.
tokenURI prepends the _baseURI prefix to the encoded metadata.
_transfer adjusts _balances for sender and receiver.
_transfer rewrites the _owners entry for the token.
transferFrom relies on _isApprovedOrOwner for authorization.
_isApprovedOrOwner compares the caller (msg.sender) against owner and approvals.
tokenId parameter selects the token moved by _transfer.
to parameter is the recipient recorded during _transfer.
_burn deletes the owner record for the burned token.
_burn decrements the previous owner balance.

normalization_plan.reason: noYears is only used to persist the token years through _setOGs.
amount is only consumed as the transferred value in withdraw.
newRoyaltiesReceiver is only used to update the royalties receiver.
_tokenId is only used as the royalty query identifier in royaltyInfo.
_salePrice is only used in the royalty arithmetic of royaltyInfo.
to is only used as the recipient recorded by _transfer.
tokenId is only used to select the token moved by _transfer.
someone is the msg.sender-derived recipient of the unsafe external transfer.
_royalties is the computed royalty amount returned by royaltyInfo.
